Jiihn Ahn is a PhD student in New Testament at Princeton Theological Seminary. His interests include postcolonial biblical criticism, reception history, and  racial-ethnic studies on Pauline Epistles and Acts of the Apostles. Jiihn is also an ordained minister in the Korean Baptist tradition. See more in [About](about.qmd) page.
